review.rationale: Reviewed AGPL-to-AGPL adaptation of the merged Cloud resolver/catalog/independence tests. Owner and imports are local, the published npm producer pin replaces the .NET pin, and npm workspace links/owned workspace releases are excluded from external dependency inventory. Image-specific argument mapping is omitted. The sealed static report is independently verified against source, locked packages and actual CI run/attempt. No sibling source becomes a build input. This successor corrects the verification description inherited from the earlier unrelated four-file provenance port; the same three target bytes and exact upstream identities remain unchanged. GOV11 ADP07 metadata binding reads the published129 build-identity ContractSet instead of the retired single-schema receipt field. All six independently declared protobuf/JSON schema subjects retain their own versions; package version never supplies a schema version. The identity owner, clean source, exact package pin, complete source hash set and applicable descriptor hashes are checked. Original upstream licence evidence is unchanged.
